label: Most Common
heading: The 500 Most Common Egyptian Arabic Words

examples.arabic: إن شاء الله كاس أفريقيا ده يكون بتاعنا يا مصريين!
examples.english: God willing, this African Cup will be ours, Egyptians!
examples.transliteration: In sha Allah kas Afrika da yekoun beta3na ya Masreyyeen!
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: البياع اداني تفاحة ببلاش وقال لنا الله يسلمك
examples.english: The seller gave me an apple for free and said to us may God keep you safe.
examples.transliteration: El-bayya' eddani toffaha bebalash wa aal lina Allah yisallimik.

examples.arabic: قلت مع السلامة وهو قال الله يسلمك
examples.english: I said "Goodbye" and he said "May God keep you safe"
examples.transliteration: 'Olt ma'a salama w howa 'al Allah yisallimak

examples.arabic: منى كانت زعلانة قوي، بس أحمد فضل قوي.
examples.english: Mona was very sad, but Ahmed stayed strong.
examples.transliteration: Mona kanet za3lana awi, bas Ahmad fadl awi.

examples.arabic: ليلى شافت ألعاب كتير بس بابا قال: مرة تانية يا حبيبتي.
examples.english: Layla saw many toys but Dad said: Another time, my dear.
examples.transliteration: Layla shafet al3ab ketir bas Baba aal: Marra tanya ya habibty.

examples.arabic: أنا بفتح الباب وهما بيدخلوا؛ الشقة بتاعتي صغيرة بس حلوة.
examples.english: I open the door and they enter; my apartment is small but nice.
examples.transliteration: Ana bafta7 el bab w homa byedkholo; el sha22a beta3ty soghayyara bas 7elwa.

examples.arabic: أول ما دخلت صاحب المحل رحب بيا وقال لي أهلًا وسهلًا إيه اللي عايز تعمله
examples.english: As soon as I entered, the shop owner welcomed me and said, "Ahlan wa Sahlan, what do you want to do?"
examples.transliteration: Awwal mā dakhelt, ṣāḥeb el-maḥall raḥḥab biya wa qāl li 'ahlan wa sahlan 'ēh illi ʿāyiz taʿmelu.
examples.storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

examples.arabic: على طول، ولاد الحتة بيروحوا يساعدوا الناس اللي محتاجة.
examples.english: Immediately, the neighborhood boys go to help people who are in need.
examples.transliteration: 3ala tool, welad el 7etta beyroo7u yesa3edu el nas elly me7taga.

examples.arabic: شفت عمي اللي بيشتغل هناك
examples.english: I saw my uncle who works there.
examples.transliteration: shoft ammi elli biyeshtaghal henak

examples.arabic: انا رحت المحل وشفت الراجل اللي بيشتغل هناك
examples.english: I went to the shop and saw the man who works there.
examples.transliteration: ana roht el mahal we shoft el ragel elly biyeshtaghal henak

examples.arabic: انا كويس والله كنت بشتري حاجات للبيت
examples.english: I'm good, by God. I was buying things for the house.
examples.transliteration: Ana kwayyes wallahi. Kont bashtary hagāt lel-beit.

examples.arabic: إن شاء الله كاس أفريقيا ده يكون بتاعنا يا مصريين!
examples.english: God willing, this African Cup will be ours, Egyptians!
examples.transliteration: In sha Allah kas Afrika da yekoun beta3na ya Masreyyeen!
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: الشعور ده باللمة بيخلينا فرحانين أوي كل مرة.
examples.english: This feeling of gathering makes us very happy every time.
examples.transliteration: El sho'our da bel lamma beykhallina farhanin awi kol marra.

examples.arabic: أخويا الكبير أحمد زعق من الفرحة وكلم أمنا فيديو عشان يوريها الجمال ده.
examples.english: My big brother Ahmed shouted with joy and called our mother on video to show her this beauty.
examples.transliteration: Akhoya el kebir Ahmed za'a men el farha we kalem omena video ashan yoriha el gamal da.

examples.arabic: يارب يجي دلوقتي بسرعة
examples.english: O Lord, I hope he comes now quickly.
examples.transliteration: Ya rab yigi delwa'ty bosor'a.

examples.arabic: أنت بتسأل: هو بيعمل إيه؟
examples.english: You ask: what is he doing?
examples.transliteration: Enta betsa2al: howa beya3mel eh?

examples.arabic: انت لازم تجيب اكل صحي معاك في الطريق
examples.english: You must bring healthy food with you on the way
examples.transliteration: enta lazem tigueeb akl sehhi maak fi el tareeq

examples.arabic: انا كويس، انت فاضي بكرة عشان نشرب شاي الصبح؟
examples.english: I am good, are you free tomorrow so we drink tea in the morning?
examples.transliteration: Ana kwayes, enta fadi bokra ashan neshrab shay el sobh?

examples.arabic: أحمد وبابا كانوا مبسوطين أوي بالنتيجة دي للماتش.
examples.english: Ahmed and Dad were very happy with this match result.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad we Baba kano mabsooteen awi bel neteega di lel match.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: الخبرة دي غيرت حياته وادته حكمة كبيرة.
examples.english: This experience changed his life and gave him great wisdom.
examples.transliteration: El khibra dee ghayyaret hayato we edet-loh hekma kibeera.

examples.arabic: المشكلة دي ليها تاريخ طويل من سنين كتيرة.
examples.english: This problem has a long history from many years ago.
examples.transliteration: El-moshkila di liha tarikh tawil min sinin ketira.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: صاحبه مارك دخل المطبخ وسأله انت بتعمل ايه يا كريم
examples.english: His friend Mark entered the kitchen and asked him, "What are you making, Karim?"
examples.transliteration: Sahbo Mark dakhal elmatbakh w sa'alo enta bete'mel eih ya Karim?

examples.arabic: قلت له صباح الخير ازيك عامل ايه
examples.english: I said to him, "Good morning, how are you, what are you doing?"
examples.transliteration: olteloh sabah el kheir azayyak amel eh

examples.arabic: الواد صحي الصبح وبيسأل ماما احنا هناكل إيه دلوقتي
examples.english: The boy woke up in the morning and is asking mom, "What are we going to eat now?"
examples.transliteration: Elwaad sehi elsobh webyes'al mama ehna hanaakol eih delwa'ty.

examples.arabic: كل واحد في الحتة كان حاسس بفرحة كبيرة عشان الفريق كان بيلعب كويس.
examples.english: Every person in the area was feeling a great joy because the team was playing well.
examples.transliteration: Kol wahed fel hetta kan hases be farha kebira ashan el fariq kan beyelab kways.

examples.arabic: كنت خايفة قوي عشان مش شايفة اي حاجة عارفاها
examples.english: I was very afraid because I didn't see anything I knew.
examples.transliteration: Kont khayfa awi ashan mesh shayfa ay haga arfaha

examples.arabic: يا احمد يلا نسافر اخر الاسبوع عشان هنكون مشغولين باقي السنه
examples.english: Ahmed let's travel this weekend because we will be busy the rest of the year
examples.transliteration: ya Ahmed yalla nesafer akher el esboo ashan hanekoon mashghoolin baqi el sana

examples.arabic: لما الماتش خلص، المشجعين مشيوا في الشوارع ومعاهم أعلام.
examples.english: When the match finished, the fans walked in the streets and with them were flags.
examples.transliteration: Lamma el matsh khalas, el moshage'in meshyo fel shaware' wa ma'ahom a'lam.

examples.arabic: انا كنت بشرب شاي الصبح في البيت لما ابن اختي جه
examples.english: I was drinking tea in the morning at home when my nephew arrived
examples.transliteration: Ana kont bashrab shay el sobh fil beit lamma ibn okhti geh

examples.arabic: انت عندك حق، الدنيا مش ماشية كويس لما مش بننام.
examples.english: You are right, the world is not going well when we do not sleep.
examples.transliteration: Enta andak hak, el donia mesh mashya kewayyes lamma mesh benenam.

examples.arabic: أنا بجمع آراء كل صحابي قبل ما أعمل اي تصويت على الديكور
examples.english: I gather opinions from all my friends before I make any vote on the decor.
examples.transliteration: Ana bagmaʿ ārāʾ koll ṣoḥāby ʾabl ma aʿmel ayy taṣwīt ʿala el-dīkōr.

examples.arabic: جدي بيشتغل كتير وبيحب اي حاجة قديمة
examples.english: My grandfather works a lot and loves any old thing.
examples.transliteration: geddy biyeshtaghal keteer wa biheb ay haga adima

examples.arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه من البيت وكنت فاكرة الطريق بس دلوقتي مش شايفة اي علامة اعرفها
examples.english: I just drove the car from home and I thought I knew the way, but now I don't see any familiar signs.
examples.transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya men el bet we kont fakra el tareeq bas delwaqty mesh shayfa ay alama a'rafha

examples.arabic: الناس كانت كتير في السوق وكلهم بيضحكوا.
examples.english: People were many in the market and all of them were laughing.
examples.transliteration: El nas kanet ketir fel soo2 we kollhom beyed7akou.

examples.arabic: على طول، ولاد الحتة بيروحوا يساعدوا الناس اللي محتاجة.
examples.english: Immediately, the neighborhood boys go to help people who are in need.
examples.transliteration: 3ala tool, welad el 7etta beyroo7u yesa3edu el nas elly me7taga.

examples.arabic: عمل الخير بيفرح الناس وبيقرب القلوب.
examples.english: Doing good makes people happy and brings hearts closer.
examples.transliteration: 3amal el kheir beyefarra7 el nas we bey2arrab el 2oloob.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: قعدنا نتكلم كتير عن أيامنا القديمة؛ كانت لحظات جميلة وسعيدة مع أصحابي.
examples.english: We sat talking a lot about our old days; they were beautiful and happy moments with my friends.
examples.transliteration: 2a3adna netkallem keteer 3an ayyamna el 2adima; kanet la7azat gameela w sa3eeda ma3 as7abi.

examples.arabic: امبارح قعدنا مع بعض واتكلمنا عن أحلامنا الجديدة.
examples.english: Yesterday we sat together and talked about our new dreams.
examples.transliteration: Embareh aadna maa baad we etkallamna aan ahlamna el gedida.

examples.arabic: أختي بتسأل عن أهداف البلاد دي.
examples.english: My sister asks about the goals of these countries.
examples.transliteration: Okhti bitisal an ahdaf el-bilad di.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: أنا جعان اوي ولما بشوف عيلتي مبسوطة كده أنا بكون مبسوط جدا
examples.english: I am very hungry, and when I see my family happy like this, I get very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ana gaaan awi w lama bashoof 3eilti mabsoota keda ana bakoon mabsoot giddan

examples.arabic: اه عشان كدة انتي شوفتي هدير انهارده الصبح
examples.english: Oh, that's why. Did you see Hadeer this morning?
examples.transliteration: Ah ashan keda inti shofti Hadeer ennaharda essobh?

examples.arabic: يا رب نقضي وقت حلو تاني مع بعض كده كل يوم
examples.english: Oh God, I hope we spend sweet time together again like this every day.
examples.transliteration: ya rab na2ady wa2t 7elw tany ma3 ba3d keda koll yom
examples.storyTitle: A Warm Day at Our Home

examples.arabic: ليلى باست مشمش وقالت: صباح الخير يا حبيبتي.
examples.english: Layla kissed Meshmesh and said: Good morning, my dear.
examples.transliteration: Layla baset Meshmesh we alet: Sabah el kheir ya habibty.

examples.arabic: انا قلت له صباح الخير
examples.english: I said good morning to him.
examples.transliteration: ana olt loh sabah elkheir

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا جاري احمد
examples.english: Good morning my neighbor Ahmed.
examples.transliteration: sabah el kheer ya gari ahmed

examples.arabic: كل يوم بنصحى بدري عشان نخطط للفرح الكبير
examples.english: Every day we wake up early to plan for the big wedding.
examples.transliteration: Koll yōm bansaa badry ʿashān nokhaṭṭeṭ lel-faraḥ el-kabīr.

examples.arabic: أحمد بيشتغل كتير كل يوم.
examples.english: Ahmed works hard every day.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad byeshtaghal keteer kol yom.

examples.arabic: ليلى قالت: النهاردة كان يوم حلو أوي يا عيلتي.
examples.english: Layla said: Today was a very nice day, my family.
examples.transliteration: Layla alet: Ennaharda kan yom helw awi ya 3eilty.

examples.arabic: أيام العيد كانت قربت أوي وماتش مصر كمان.
examples.english: Eid days were very close, and Egypt's match was also coming soon.
examples.transliteration: Ayam el Eid kanet 2arabet awi w match Masr kaman.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: يا رب الكاس يفضل في مصر السنة دي.
examples.english: Oh Lord, may the cup stay in Egypt this year.
examples.transliteration: Ya rab el kas yefdal fi masr el sana di.

examples.arabic: النهاردة أول يوم في العيد الكبير في مصر.
examples.english: Today is the first day of the big holiday in Egypt.
examples.transliteration: En-naharda awwil yom fi el-eid el-kebir fi masr.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: العيلة كانت مبسوطة تاني بعد كده.
examples.english: The family was happy again after that.
examples.transliteration: El 3eila kanet mabsoota tani ba3d keda.

examples.arabic: كل يوم بعد المدرسة، كانوا بيتجمعوا.
examples.english: Every day after school, they gathered.
examples.transliteration: Kol yom ba3d el madrasa, kano beyetgammo3o.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: إحنا بنشرب شاي بعد الأكل.
examples.english: We drink tea after eating.
examples.transliteration: E7na benshrab shay ba3d el 2akl.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: هو سأل ليه الشاي سخن وليه بابا بيشتغل كتير كل يوم
examples.english: He asked why the tea is hot and why dad works a lot every day
examples.transliteration: Howa sa-al leh el shay sokhn we leh baba biyeshtaghal kteer kol yom
examples.storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

examples.arabic: بيقول بابا ليه الشمس حر
examples.english: He says dad why is the sun hot.
examples.transliteration: biyoul baba leh el shams har

examples.arabic: هو بيقول ليه السما زرقا
examples.english: He says why is the sky blue.
examples.transliteration: howa beyool leh el sama zarka

examples.arabic: هي كانت معاها خمسين جنيه بس، يعني مش كفاية لكل القماش ده.
examples.english: She only had fifty pounds with her, meaning it wasn't enough for all this fabric.
examples.transliteration: Heyya kanet ma3aha khamsin gineih bas, ya3ny mish kefaya le koll el-oumash dah.

examples.arabic: منى كان معاها خمسين جنيه بس في شنطتها؛ يعني ده سعر كويس، بس هي كانت قلقانة.
examples.english: Mona only had fifty pounds in her bag; meaning, this was a good price, but she was worried.
examples.transliteration: Mona kan ma'aha khamseen geneh bas fi shantetha; ya'ni dah se'r kwayyes, bas heya kanet 'alqana.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: هي معاها تمانين جنيه بس، وقالتله: "يا عمو، طب يعني معلش، مفيش أي حاجة أقل من كده؟ ده أنا طالبة غلبانة ومش هعرف أخلّص المشروع بتاعي من غيره."
examples.english: She only had eighty pounds, and she told him: "Uncle, well, I mean, sorry, isn't there anything less than that? I'm a poor student and I won't be able to finish my project without it."
examples.transliteration: Heya ma3aha tamaneen geneh bas, we qaletlo: "Ya 3ammo, tab ya3ni ma3lesh, mafish ay haga a'all men keda? Da ana taliba ghalabana we mesh ha3raf akhalles el-mashrou3 beta3i men gheero."

examples.arabic: هم فكروا يعملوا حاجة حلوة ليها.
examples.english: They thought of doing something nice for her.
examples.transliteration: Hom fakkaru ya3malo 7aga 7elwa leeha.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: احنا عندنا احلام كتير وعايزين نعمل حاجة
examples.english: We have many dreams and want to do something.
examples.transliteration: ehna andena ahlam keteer wa ayzeen neamel haga

examples.arabic: كل واحد فينا بيعمل حاجة مهمة كل يوم
examples.english: Every one of us does something important every day
examples.transliteration: Kull wahed feena biyemel haga mohemma kull yom

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: رجعت البيت تعبان بس قلبي كان مليان فرحة.
examples.english: I returned home tired but my heart was full of joy.
examples.transliteration: ragaat el beyt taaban bas alby kan malyan farha.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: قلبي كان بيدق بسرعة و كنت خايفة ارجع البيت ازاي
examples.english: My heart was beating fast and I was afraid how I would return home.
examples.transliteration: Alby kan bydo' be-sor'a w kont khayfa arga' el bayt ezayy.

examples.arabic: هي دايماً بتعمل أكل حلو لينا كلنا، وأولادي بيحبوه أوي.
examples.english: She always makes delicious food for all of us, and my children love it very much.
examples.transliteration: Heya dayman beta3mel akl helw leena kollena, w awladi bey7ebboh awi.

examples.arabic: هي كانت بتحب الزيارات بتاعت ولاد الحتة.
examples.english: She used to love the visits of the neighborhood kids.
examples.transliteration: Heya kanet bet7ebb el zeyarat beta3et welad el 7etta.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: هي كانت بتضحك وبتقول لنا: "ربنا يخليكم ليا يا ولادي وتفضلوا دايما مع بعض."
examples.english: She was laughing and telling us: "May God keep you for me, my children, and may you always stay together."
examples.transliteration: Heya kanet betedhak we betolena: 'Rabbena yekhalikom leya ya weladi we tefdalo dayman ma'a ba'ad.'

examples.arabic: اهلا بيك يا جدي كريم جاي يسلم عليك
examples.english: Welcome to you, Grandpa! Karim is coming to greet you.
examples.transliteration: Ahlan beek ya geddi, Karim gayy yisallim 3aleek.

examples.arabic: طيب انا رايحه اشتري حاجات من السوق عايزة حاجه
examples.english: Okay, I'm going to buy some things from the market, do you want anything?
examples.transliteration: Tayeb ana rayha ashtiri hagat min es souq, ayza haga?

examples.arabic: طيب يا حبيبتي فين المكان الجديد ده
examples.english: Okay my dear. Where is this new place?
examples.transliteration: Tayeb ya habibty feen el makan el gedid da.

examples.arabic: طيب تشربي شاي ولا قهوة عندنا
examples.english: Okay, would you like to drink tea or coffee with us?
examples.transliteration: Tayeb, teshraaby shay wala ahwa andena?

examples.arabic: الحمد لله انا كويس وبشرب شاي الصبح
examples.english: Thank God I am good and drinking tea in the morning.
examples.transliteration: elhamdullelah ana kwayes wa bashrab shay el sobh

examples.arabic: كل حاجة كويسة والحمد لله
examples.english: Everything is good and thank God
examples.transliteration: Kol haga kwayesa welhamdullelah

examples.arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله وبشرب شاي الصبح في البيت
examples.english: I am good thank God and I drink tea in the morning at home
examples.transliteration: Ana kwayes elhamdullelah wa bashrab shay el sobh fel beit

examples.arabic: بعدين رجعوا بيتهم الجميل مبسوطين جداً.
examples.english: Then they returned to their beautiful house, very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein reg'ou beithom el gamil mabsootein geddan.

examples.arabic: مصطفى: أيوه، الحمد لله، هما كويسين جداً.
examples.english: Mostafa: Yes, praise be to God, they are very good.
examples.transliteration: Mostafa: Aywa, elhamdulillah, homa kwayyeseen geddan.

examples.arabic: ريحة الأكل كانت جميلة جداً.
examples.english: The smell of the food was very beautiful.
examples.transliteration: Ree7et el 2akl kanet gamila geddan.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: قطتها اسمها "مشمش" ولونها أبيض زي الثلج.
examples.english: Her cat's name is "Meshmesh" and its color is white like snow.
examples.transliteration: Ottetha esmaha "Meshmesh" we lonha abyad zay el talg.

examples.arabic: فجأة السما بدأت تمطر حاجات بيضا زي قطع القطن الصغيرة.
examples.english: Suddenly, the sky started raining white things like small pieces of cotton.
examples.transliteration: Fag'a el sama bada'et temattar hagat beida zay eta'a el otn el soghayara.

examples.arabic: هل القطر سريع زي الطلقه ولا بطيء
examples.english: Is the train fast like a bullet or slow
examples.transliteration: hal el atr sarea zay el tala wala batee

examples.arabic: يمكن لو قعدت استنى عشرين دقيقة تاني يحصل معجزة ونقول امين
examples.english: Maybe if I wait twenty more minutes a miracle will happen and we'll say amen.
examples.transliteration: yemken law ʾa3adt astanna 3išrīn deʾīʾa tānī yeḥṣal mo3geza w neʾūl amīn.

examples.arabic: ليلى باست مشمش وقالت: صباح الخير يا حبيبتي.

examples.arabic: وفي لقطة كوميدية لا تنسى زميلنا علي قرر يشوط الكورة بكل قوته في سلة الزبالة اللي كانت جنب الجون بدل ما يجيبها جوه الشبكة
examples.english: And in an unforgettable comedic moment, our colleague Ali decided to kick the ball with all his might into the trash can next to the goal instead of putting it inside the net.
examples.transliteration: We fi laqta komedeya la tounsa zemeelna Ali qarar yeshoot el-koora be koll qowweto fi sallit ez-zebala elly kanet ganb el-goon badal ma yegibha gowwa esh-shabaka.

examples.arabic: بس بعدين اكتشفت اني حطيت ملح بدل السكر بالغلط
examples.english: But then I discovered that I had put salt instead of sugar by mistake.
examples.transliteration: Bas ba'dein ektashaft enni hateit malh badal el sokkar bel ghalat.

examples.arabic: أنا وصحابي عايزين نشوف المنتخب في الماتش النهائي.
examples.english: My friends and I want to see the national team in the final match.
examples.transliteration: Ana wa sahabi ayzin neshouf el montakhab fel matsh el neha'i.

examples.arabic: كنا عايزين نشوف التلج لأول مرة في حياتنا عشان مش بنشوفه خالص في القاهرة.
examples.english: We wanted to see the snow for the first time in our lives because we never see it at all in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Konna ayzin neshouf el talg le awel marra fi hayatna ashan mesh benshoufo khales fi el kahera.

examples.arabic: الرؤساء عايزين سلطة و سيطرة في المنطقة.
examples.english: The presidents want power and control in the region.
examples.transliteration: El-ruasa ayzin sulta wa saytara fi el-mantiqa.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: أخويا الكبير أحمد زعق من الفرحة وكلم أمنا فيديو عشان يوريها الجمال ده.
examples.english: My big brother Ahmed shouted with joy and called our mother on video to show her this beauty.
examples.transliteration: Akhoya el kebir Ahmed za'a men el farha we kalem omena video ashan yoriha el gamal da.

examples.arabic: فجأة، اللاعب المصري جاب جون، وكل الناس صرخوا من الفرحة.
examples.english: Suddenly, the Egyptian player scored a goal, and all the people screamed from joy.
examples.transliteration: Fagaa, el la'eb el masry gab gon, wa kol el nas sarakho mel farha.

examples.arabic: وفجأة لاعب من الفريق الازرق جاب جون عالمي والتشجيع زاد
examples.english: Suddenly, a player from the blue team scored an amazing goal and the cheering increased.
examples.transliteration: Wi faga'a la'eb min el fareeq el azraq gab goon 'alamy wal tashgee' zad

examples.arabic: لاعب جاب جون حلو اوي
examples.english: A player scored a very nice goal.
examples.transliteration: La'eb gab goon helw awy

examples.arabic: كل كلمة قالتها أو سمعتها كانت جزء من يومها الطبيعي في القاهرة، بتضيف لجمال وتنوع الحياة اليومية هناك.
examples.english: Every word she said or heard was a part of her normal day in Cairo, adding to the beauty and diversity of daily life there.

examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

examples.arabic: جده كان فاهم زمان ان الحياة بسيطة
examples.english: His grandfather understood in the past that life was simple.
examples.transliteration: geddo kān fāhim zamān inn el-ḥayāh basīṭa

examples.arabic: هما قعدوا يتكلموا عشان يخططوا لمده اربعه ساعات
examples.english: They sat talking to plan for four hours.
examples.transliteration: Homa 'a'ado yetkallemo 'ashan yekhatato lemoddet arba'a sa'at.

examples.arabic: انا بستغرب ازاي ممكن الناس تقعد ساعات تتكلم عن كل حاجة صغيرة
examples.english: I wonder how people can sit for hours talking about every small thing
examples.transliteration: Ana bastaghreb izzay mumkin en-nās tiq3od sā3āt tetkallim 3an kull ḥāga ṣughayyara

examples.arabic: كل كلمة قالتها أو سمعتها كانت جزء من يومها الطبيعي في القاهرة، بتضيف لجمال وتنوع الحياة اليومية هناك.
examples.english: Every word she said or heard was a part of her normal day in Cairo, adding to the beauty and diversity of daily life there.

examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

examples.arabic: صاحب المحل قال آسف يا فندم
examples.english: The shop owner said: Sorry, sir.
examples.transliteration: Sa7eb elma7al 'al: Asif ya fanadem.

examples.arabic: طلع إن القطة كان عندها ميعاد مع صاحب الكلب
examples.english: It turned out that the cat had an appointment with the dog's owner!
examples.transliteration: Tala' en el 'oTTa kan 'andaha me'aad ma' SaHeb el kalb
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

examples.arabic: صاحب المحل كان طيب جدا وقالي مفيش مشكلة واداني غيره
examples.english: The shop owner was very kind and told me "no problem", and gave me new ones.
examples.transliteration: Saheb el mahal kan tayeb geddan we ali mafish moshkela we eddani gheero

examples.arabic: ليلى نامت وهي بتحلم بألعابها الجديدة اللي هتاخدها بكره.
examples.english: Layla slept while she was dreaming of her new toys that she would get tomorrow.
examples.transliteration: Layla namet we heya bete7lam be al3abha el gedida elly hatakhodha bokra.

examples.arabic: طنط خديجة فتحت الباب وهي مبسوطة.
examples.english: Tanta Khadiga opened the door and she was happy.
examples.transliteration: Tanta Khadiga fata7et el bab we hya mabsoota.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: قعدنا نتكلم كتير وهي كانت بتحكيلي عن جارتها صاحبة البيت اللي جنبهم
examples.english: We sat and talked a lot, and she was telling me about her neighbor, the female friend of the house next to them.
examples.transliteration: Qa'adnā netkallem kitīr w hiya kānet beteḥkīlī 3an gāret-hā ṣāḥibet el-bēt elly ganbuhom.

examples.arabic: عم محمود شال صينية صغيرة معاهم.
examples.english: Uncle Mahmoud carried a small tray with them.
examples.transliteration: 3amm Mahmoud shal senei'a soghayara ma3ahom.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: العيلة هي كل حاجة في حياتي، وأنا فرحان معاهم.
examples.english: Family is everything in my life, and I am happy with them.
examples.transliteration: El eila heya kol haga fee hayaty, we ana farhan maahom.

examples.arabic: لما روحت بيتي بالليل كلمت اصحابي عشان انا بكون مبسوط لما بتكلم معاهم
examples.english: When I went home at night, I called my friends because I get happy when I talk with them.
examples.transliteration: Lamma rowwaht beiti bel leil kallamt ashabi ashan ana bakoon mabsoot lamma batkallem ma'ahom

examples.arabic: بابا بيقول إن الموضوع محتاج حكم كويس زي حكم القضاء
examples.english: My dad says the matter needs good judgment like the judgment of the judiciary.
examples.transliteration: Bābā biyʾūl en el-mawḍūʿ meḥtāg ḥokm kowayyes zayy ḥokm el-qaḍāʾ.

examples.arabic: بابا قال: إحنا لازم نروح السوق النهاردة يا حلوين.
examples.english: Dad said: We must go to the market today, my dears.
examples.transliteration: Baba aal: Ehna lazam narouh el soo2 ennaharda ya helwein.

examples.arabic: بابا اشترى لحمة من الجزار.
examples.english: Dad bought meat from the butcher.
examples.transliteration: Baba eshtara la7ma men el gazzar.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: انا شايف طماطم حمرا ولمون اصفر
examples.english: I see red tomatoes and yellow lemons
examples.transliteration: ana shayef tamatem hamra we lamoon asfar

examples.arabic: شايف المطر بره الشباك
examples.english: I see the rain outside the window.
examples.transliteration: Shayef el matar barra el shobak

examples.arabic: شايف شجرة كبيرة برا وناس كتير بتتكلم
examples.english: I see a big tree outside and many people talking.
examples.transliteration: Shayef shagara kebeera barra we nas kiteer betetkallem.

examples.arabic: حلو اوي، وانا هشوف فيلم جديد في وقت فراغي.
examples.english: Very nice, and I will watch a new movie in my free time.
examples.transliteration: Helw awi, wa ana hashoof film gedid fi wakt faraghi.

examples.arabic: فقلت اعمل شاي سخن واقعد اتفرج على فيلم جديد على نيتفليكس
examples.english: So I decided to make hot tea and sit and watch a new movie on Netflix.
examples.transliteration: fa olt aamel shay sokhn w aod atfarag ala film gedid ala netflix

examples.arabic: انا لسه شايفه فيلم حلو امبارح نفسي احكيلها عليه
examples.english: I just watched a nice movie yesterday, I want to tell her about it.
examples.transliteration: ana lessa shayfa film helw embareh nafsi ahkelha aleih

examples.arabic: ديما بيبقوا فاكرين ان الصداقة الحقيقية بتفضل لاي جيل مهما اتغيرت الظروف
examples.english: They always remember that true friendship lasts for any generation no matter how circumstances change
examples.transliteration: Dima be-yeb'u fakrin en el-sada'a el-haqi'iyya betefdal le-ay geel mahma etghayyaret el-zourouf

examples.arabic: ديما، كل الجيران بيحبوا أولادنا وبيقولوا إنهم أحسن أصحاب في الحي بتاعنا.
examples.english: Always, all the neighbors love our children and say that they are the best friends in our neighborhood.
examples.transliteration: Dayman, kol el giran bey7ebbu awladna w bey2oolo ennohom a7san as7ab fel 7ayy beta3na.

examples.arabic: لما اللعيبة خططوا صح للجون فهمت انهم هيكسبوا
examples.english: When the players planned correctly for the goal, I understood they would win
examples.transliteration: Lamma el-la'eeba khaTTatu saHH lel-goon fahimt innohom hayeksabo

examples.arabic: لما وصلت كانوا سعداء جدا انهم شافوني
examples.english: When I arrived, they were very happy to see me.
examples.transliteration: Lamma wasalt kaanu so'adaa' giddan ennahom shaafuuni.

examples.arabic: ده مقاسي بالظبط ومش غالي
examples.english: This is exactly my size and not expensive.
examples.transliteration: Da ma'asy belzabt w mesh ghali.

examples.arabic: قومت اشوف ايه اللي حصل بالظبط
examples.english: I got up to see exactly what happened.
examples.transliteration: ʔumt ashūf ēh illi ḥaṣal biẓ-ẓabṭ.

examples.arabic: الكتاب كان أزرق غامق، بالظبط زي ما أستاذها وصف، بس سعرُه كان مكتوب عشرين جنيه بس.
examples.english: The book was dark blue, exactly as her professor described, but its price was written only twenty pounds.
examples.transliteration: El ketab kan azraq ghame' bilzabt zay ma ostazha wassaf, bas se'ro kan maktoob 'eshreen geneh bas.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: قطتها اسمها "مشمش" ولونها أبيض زي الثلج.
examples.english: Her cat's name is "Meshmesh" and its color is white like snow.
examples.transliteration: Ottetha esmaha "Meshmesh" we lonha abyad zay el talg.

examples.arabic: أحمد قال لصاحبه علي: الجو هنا جميل أوي النهاردة.
examples.english: Ahmed said to his friend Ali: The atmosphere here is very beautiful today.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed al le sahbo Ali: El gaw hena gamil awi ennaharda.

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: ابويا حضن اخويا جامد والجو الدافي ملى الصالة
examples.english: My dad hugged my brother tightly and the warm atmosphere filled the living room.
examples.transliteration: abouya hadan akhouya gamed wel gaw el dafy mala el sala
examples.storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

examples.arabic: احنا هنرقص ونغني طول الليل
examples.english: We will dance and sing all night.
examples.transliteration: ehna hanorqos we noghanny tool el leyl

examples.arabic: كل صحابهم واهلهم هييجوا ويقعدوا مبسوطين طول الليل
examples.english: All their friends and family will come and sit happily all night.
examples.transliteration: Koll sohabhum w ahluhum hayigu w ya'oodu mabsuutin tuul el liil

examples.arabic: مُنى كانت بتذاكر طول الليل. أخوها بيتفرج على تلفزيون.
examples.english: Mona was studying all night. Her brother was watching TV.
examples.transliteration: Mona kanet betzakir tool el-leil. Akhooha beyetfarag 3ala televizion.

examples.arabic: كل بنات العيلة بيساعدوا
examples.english: All the girls in the family are helping.
examples.transliteration: Kol banat el-3eila beyza3doo.

examples.arabic: بعد الحصة قابلوا المدرسة وقالت اهلا وسهلا يا بنات
examples.english: After class, they met the teacher, and she said "Welcome, girls."
examples.transliteration: Ba'd el-hessa abelo el-modarresa w alet ahlan wa sahlan ya banat.

examples.arabic: بياع الفُل، اللي كان شايل حلة كبيرة، ابتسم وقال بصوت عالي: صباح الخير يا ست البنات! تحبي تاكلي فُل سخن؟
examples.english: The ful vendor, who was carrying a large pot, smiled and said loudly: "Good morning, lady of all girls! Would you like to eat hot ful?"
examples.transliteration: Bayya3 el-ful, elly kan shayel 7ella kebira, ebtesem w 'al be-sout 3ali: "Sabah el-kheir ya sett el-banat! Te7ebbi takli ful sokhn?"
examples.storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: ليلى ساعدت مامتها ترص الحاجات اللي اشتروها.
examples.english: Layla helped her mom arrange the things they bought.
examples.transliteration: Layla sa3adet mametha teros el hagat elly eshtarouha.

examples.arabic: احنا بنحب ناكل الحاجات دي كل يوم وهي فاضية
examples.english: We love to eat these things every day and it was empty.
examples.transliteration: E7na benhebb nakol el-hagat di kolle yom w heya fadya
examples.storyTitle: The Home Problem and the Market

examples.arabic: الجد استغرب من اسئلته الحاجات دي كانت عادي بالنسبة له
examples.english: The grandfather was surprised by his questions; these things were normal for him.
examples.transliteration: El-gadd istaghrab min as'ilto, el-ḥagāt di kanet 3ādi bel-nesba lo.

examples.arabic: فين احمد يا رب يجي بسرعة
examples.english: Where is Ahmed? I hope he comes quickly.
examples.transliteration: Feen Ahmed ya rab yigi besor'a

examples.arabic: يا رب يجي بسرعة عشان نشرب قهوة سوا
examples.english: I hope he comes quickly so we can drink coffee together.
examples.transliteration: Ya rab yigi be-sor'a 'ashan neshrab ahwa sawa.

examples.arabic: بابا بيقول إن الموضوع محتاج حكم كويس زي حكم القضاء
examples.english: My dad says the matter needs good judgment like the judgment of the judiciary.
examples.transliteration: Bābā biyʾūl en el-mawḍūʿ meḥtāg ḥokm kowayyes zayy ḥokm el-qaḍāʾ.

examples.arabic: أحمد بيقول: 'أنا عايز شاي،' ومنى بتقول: 'أنا كمان بشرب شاي.' فبصب لهم الشاي في الكوبايات.
examples.english: Ahmed says: 'I want tea,' and Mona says: 'I also drink tea.' So I pour them the tea into the cups.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed byea2ul: 'Ana 3ayez shay,' w Mona bet2ul: 'Ana kaman bashrab shay.' Fa basobb lehom el shay fel kobbayat.

examples.arabic: الراجل بيقول البيت جنب الجامع الكبير
examples.english: The man says the house is next to the big mosque.
examples.transliteration: el ragel beyeool el beit ganb el gameaa el kebeer

examples.arabic: طبعاً يا بنتي، خليهم. الشاي بتاعنا مشهور، يبقى عظيم وبنقترحه.
examples.english: Of course, my daughter, keep them. Our tea is famous, it will be great, and we recommend it.
examples.transliteration: Tab'an ya benti, khalleehom. Esh-shay beta'na mashhoor, yeb'a 3azeem waben'tare7o.

examples.arabic: خليهم يلعبوا على البحر براحتهم و يبقى يوم عظيم لينا كلنا
examples.english: Let them play on the beach freely, and it will be a great day for all of us.
examples.transliteration: Khaleehom yel3abo 3al ba7r bara7ethom w yeb2a yom 3azeem leena kollena.

examples.arabic: عمر فرح وقال: عظيم يا عم، متشكرين خالص، مع السلامة!
examples.english: Omar was happy and said: 'Great, uncle, thanks a lot, goodbye!'
examples.transliteration: Omar faraḥ wi 'al: '3azeem ya 3amm, mitshakkerin khalis, ma3 es-salama!'

examples.arabic: كل واحد في الحتة كان حاسس بفرحة كبيرة عشان الفريق كان بيلعب كويس.
examples.english: Every person in the area was feeling a great joy because the team was playing well.
examples.transliteration: Kol wahed fel hetta kan hases be farha kebira ashan el fariq kan beyelab kways.

examples.arabic: هو كان حاسس بشوية قلق عشان مكنش عنده خبرة.
examples.english: He was feeling a bit of anxiety because he didn't have experience.

examples.arabic: هو حاسس إنه مبسوط قوي عشان هو بيتعلم كتير.
examples.english: He feels very happy because he is learning a lot.
examples.transliteration: Huwa hases inu mabsut awi ashan huwa biyitalem ketir.

examples.arabic: اكيد بابا هو مرشحنا الوحيد للمشاكل دي في البيت
examples.english: Of course Dad, he's our only candidate for these problems at home.
examples.transliteration: Akīd baba, howa morashshaḥna el-waḥīd lel-mashākel dī fel-bēt.

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: هما عايشين في بيت بسيط في القاهرة.
examples.english: They live in a simple house in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Homa 3ayeshin fi beit baset fi El Qahera.

examples.arabic: ركبوا العربية بتاعتهم وراحوا السوق الكبير في القاهرة.
examples.english: They got into their car and went to the big market in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Rakbou el 3arabeya beta3ethom we rahou el soo2 el kebir fi el Qahera.

examples.arabic: أحمد راح السوق الكبير في القاهرة امبارح.
examples.english: Ahmed went to the big market in Cairo yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed rah el sooq el kebir fel Qahera embareh.

examples.arabic: عمر بيحب البحر وهو فرحان قوي
examples.english: Omar loves the sea and he is very happy.

examples.english: Sarah replied to him and said welcome to you I am good praise be to God.
examples.transliteration: Sara raddet aaleeh wa aalet ahlan beek ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah.

examples.arabic: اهلا بيك معايا في الرحلة
examples.english: Welcome to you with me on the trip
examples.transliteration: Ahlan beek maaya fi el rehla

examples.arabic: سلمت عليه وقلت له السلام عليكم يا احمد ازيك انا كويس الحمد لله فرد علي وقاللي اهلا بيك مش معقول
examples.english: I greeted him and said, "Hello Ahmed, how are you? I'm good, alhamdulillah." He replied, "Welcome, unbelievable!"

examples.arabic: قلت له ان الشباب دلوقتي بتحب تلبس الوان كتير في الرياضة
examples.english: I told him that the youth nowadays love to wear many colors in sports.
examples.transliteration: olt loh en el shabab delwaaty betheb telbes alwaan keteer fi el reyada

examples.arabic: لكن الشباب كانوا عايزين اغاني جديدة ويرقصوا
examples.english: But the youth wanted new songs and to dance.
examples.transliteration: Laken el shabab kanu ayzin aghani gedida w yor'osu.

examples.arabic: الشباب عايزين اتنين او تلاته اماكن جديدة فيها بحر او العاب
examples.english: The youth want two or three new places with a beach or games.
examples.transliteration: El shabab ayzeen etneen aw talata amaken gedida feeha bahr aw al'ab.

examples.arabic: فريقي كسب الماتش المهم ده
examples.english: My team won this important match.
examples.transliteration: Fareeqy keseb el match el mohem da

examples.arabic: سارة قالت أنا هروق الشقة وأجهز الغدا بدري عشان عندي مشوار مهم
examples.english: Sara said: I will tidy the apartment and prepare lunch early because I have an important errand.
examples.transliteration: Sara qalet ana ha-rawwaq el-shaqqa w aghahhez el-ghada badri ashan andi meshwar mohem.

examples.arabic: صباح النور يا مدام سارة معلش عندي مشوار مهم ومحدش فاضي يوصلني
examples.english: Good morning, Mrs. Sara, sorry, I have an important errand and no one is free to drive me.
examples.transliteration: Sabah el noor ya madam Sara, ma'lesh 'andy meshwar mohem we mahaddesh fady yewassalny.

examples.arabic: انا قولت يلا بينا نلعب تاني
examples.english: I said "Let's play again!"
examples.transliteration: Ana 'olt "yalla beena nel'ab tani!"

examples.arabic: شفت راجل كبير، قولت عفواً يا عمو
examples.english: I saw an old man, I said "Excuse me, uncle".
examples.transliteration: Shoft ragel kibeer, olt "Afwan ya ammu".

examples.arabic: قولت صباح الخير يا كريم ازيك
examples.english: I said, "Good morning, Karim! How are you?"
examples.transliteration: Oult Sabah el kheer ya Karim izzayak

examples.arabic: يا رب الكاس يفضل في مصر السنة دي.
examples.english: Oh Lord, may the cup stay in Egypt this year.
examples.transliteration: Ya rab el kas yefdal fi masr el sana di.

examples.arabic: يا احمد يلا نسافر اخر الاسبوع عشان هنكون مشغولين باقي السنه
examples.english: Ahmed let's travel this weekend because we will be busy the rest of the year
examples.transliteration: ya Ahmed yalla nesafer akher el esboo ashan hanekoon mashghoolin baqi el sana

examples.arabic: انا هكون مبسوط باقي السنه
examples.english: I will be happy the rest of the year.
examples.transliteration: ana hakoon mabsoot baqi el sana

examples.arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله بيتي قريب من هنا تحب تشرب مايه
examples.english: "I'm good, thank God. My house is close by. Would you like to drink some water?"
examples.transliteration: Ana kowayyes el-hamdu lellah. Beyti 'arayyeb men hena. Tehebb teshrob mayya?

examples.arabic: البياع قال له عندي قهوة شاي وعصير تحب ايه
examples.english: The salesman told him, "I have coffee, tea, and juice. What do you like?"
examples.transliteration: El-bayya' al-lo a'andy ahwa shay wa a'seer teheb eh.

examples.arabic: يا احمد تحب تشرب إيه
examples.english: Oh Ahmed what would you like to drink?
examples.transliteration: Ya Ahmed teheb tishrab eh?

examples.arabic: عرفت ان ابوك بيشتغل كتير بس العيلة كلها كويسة
examples.english: I knew that your father works a lot but the whole family is good
examples.transliteration: Araft en abouk biyeshtaghal ketir bas el eila kolaha kwayesa

examples.arabic: مع السلامة يا عمو. قالت منى بعد ما عرفت الطريق.
examples.english: Goodbye, uncle. Mona said after she knew the way.
examples.transliteration: Ma'a el-salama ya 'ammo. Qalet Mona ba'd ma 'arefet el-tareeq.

examples.arabic: بس لما روحت البيت عرفت انها مش مقاسي
examples.english: But when I went home, I knew it wasn't my size.
examples.transliteration: Bas lamma rowwa7t el beet 3ereft ennaha mesh ma2asi.

examples.arabic: دلوقتي احنا هنذاكر عشان الامتحان بكره
examples.english: Now we will study for the exam tomorrow
examples.transliteration: delwaety ehna hanezaker ashan el emtehan bokra

examples.arabic: فكر في أبوه اللي كان بيعلمه "لازم تكون واضح يا ابني"، وبص على الوادل اللي باين عليه بيروح الشغل كل يوم ده، وقرر إنه لازم يطلب حالا عشان لازم ندرس للامتحان.
examples.english: He thought of his father, who always taught him, "You must be clear, my son," and looked at the waiter who clearly goes to work every day, then decided he must order now because they must study for the exam.
examples.transliteration: Fakkar fi abooh elly kan beya'allimoh "lazim takoon wadeh ya ebny," w bass 'ala el-wadil elly bayen 'aleih beyrouh esh-shoghl koll yom dah, w qarar enno lazim yetlob halan 'ashan lazim nedres lel-emtehan.

examples.arabic: علي شرح له مشكلته، وعمو محمود رد: "بالظبط! أنا معايا كتاب الدرس اللي أنت عايزه ده، خده. أنا بروح الشغل كل يوم بعد القهوة. أنت لازم تدرس للامتحان كويس جداً." علي رد: "ألف شكر يا عمو! مع السلامة دلوقتي، أنا لازم أروح أذاكر بيه فوراً!"
examples.english: Aly explained his problem to him, and Uncle Mahmoud replied: "Exactly! I have the lesson book you want, take it. I go to work every day after the coffeehouse. You must study very well for the exam." Aly responded: "A thousand thanks, Uncle! Goodbye for now, I must go study with it immediately!"
examples.transliteration: Aly sharah lu mushkeltu, w ammo Mahmoud radd: "Bel-zabt! Ana ma'aya ketab el-dars elli enta ayezuh da, khoduh. Ana baruh el-shoghl kull yom ba'd el-ahwa. Enta lazim tedrus lel-emtihan kwayyes geddan." Aly radd: "Alf shokr ya ammo! Ma'a el-salama delwa'ty, ana lazim aruh azaker beih fawran!"
examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: هي قالت خد فنجان شاي
examples.english: She said take a cup of tea.
examples.transliteration: heya alet khod fengan shay

examples.arabic: هو إدى عمر الساندوتش وقاله: "خد يا ابني، ولا يهمك".
examples.english: He gave Omar the sandwich and told him: "Take it my son, do not worry".
examples.transliteration: Howa idda Omar el sandwitsh wa aalo: "khod ya ibnee, wala yehemmak".

examples.arabic: قالي امشي طوالي وبعدين خد يمين وبعدين شمال
examples.english: He told me "Go straight, then take a right, then a left".
examples.transliteration: Qali emshi tawali w ba'dein khod yemeen w ba'dein shemal.
